teaser.en: Its leaves are so rough that carvers use them as sandpaper, and its name means just that.
teaser.sw: Majani yake yanakwaruza mno hivi kwamba wachongaji huyatumia kama msasa, na jina lake linamaanisha hivyo hasa.
teaser.dg: Makodzage ganakaraza sana hata atu anaotsonga nkugahumira dza msasa, na hiyo ndiyo mana ya dzinare.

summary.en: *Msasa*, the sandpaper fig, is a small fig tree of forest edges whose leaves are rough enough to smooth wood. Carvers use them to finish their carvings.
summary.sw: *Msasa* ni mtini mdogo wa pembezoni mwa misitu ambao majani yake yanakwaruza kiasi cha kulainisha mbao. Wachongaji huyatumia kumalizia vinyago vyao.
summary.dg: *Msasa* (kpwa Chingereza *sandpaper fig*) ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya kuyu wa kanda za matsaka, ambao makodzage ganakaraza chiasi cha kuweza kulainisha mbao. Atu anaotsonga nkugahumira kulainisha vitu virivyotsongbwa.

about.en: *Msasa* is a small fig tree. Run a hand over its leaves and you will feel why it has its name: the surface is extremely rough, like sandpaper. Like other figs, it has milky sap and small figs.
about.sw: *Msasa* ni mtini mdogo. Pitisha mkono juu ya majani yake na utahisi kwa nini una jina hili: uso wake unakwaruza mno, kama karatasi ya msasa. Kama mitini mingine, una utomvu mweupe kama maziwa na tini ndogo.
about.dg: *Msasa* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya kuyu. Uchiguta makodzage kpwa mkpwono undamanya mana ya dzinare: ganakaraza sana, dza msasa. Dza kuyu zanjina, una maziya na matunda madide ga kuyu.

where.en: It grows at forest edges and in secondary bush.
where.sw: Huota pembezoni mwa misitu na katika vichaka vya pili.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka na kpwenye vitsaka virivyomera tsena.

uses.en: The leaves are used as sandpaper to smooth wood carvings.
uses.sw: Majani hutumika kama msasa kulainisha vinyago vya mbao.
uses.dg: Makodza nkuhumirwa dza msasa kulainisha vitu vya mbao virivyotsongbwa.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *msasa*, meaning 'sandpaper'. It is also the Swahili name. In English it is the sandpaper fig. It should not be confused with the English 'msasa', which is used for *Brachystegia spiciformis*, the tree the Digo call *mrihi*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *msasa*, lenye maana ya 'msasa' (karatasi ya kulainishia). Hili pia ndilo jina la Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *sandpaper fig*. Usichanganye na jina la Kiingereza *msasa*, linalotumika kwa *Brachystegia spiciformis*, mti ambao Wadigo huuita *mrihi*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *msasa*, ambaro ni neno ra Chidigo ra *sandpaper*. Piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *sandpaper fig*. Usiutsanganye na *msasa* wa Chingereza, dzina rinarohumirwa kpwa *Brachystegia spiciformis*, muhi ambao Adigo anauiha *mrihi*.
